# Forest interoperability fixture

`sha256-pack.forest.car.zst` was generated on 2026-11-13 with the official
Forest 0.39.0 macOS ARM64 release (`forest-tool 0.39.0+git.7f63144`). The
release zip SHA-256 was
`a6bc8dac35e3e77b1768fa9b24b4955603f29b5383d705c04fb2bc926483ff69`,
matching the GitHub release asset digest. Source reference:
https://github.com/ChainSafe/forest/tree/7f63144 .

The input was an Otehon Pack CARv1 payload generated by the pinned `awai.fs.car`
codec from 140,000 bytes at position `i` = `(19*i + floor(i/8191)) mod 256`.
Its SHA-256 was
`701516ad021619b499db5b049e91a00bc329b589c08b5209b09879394df1c2ff`.

```
forest-tool snapshot compress sample2.car --output-path sha256-pack.forest.car.zst --frame-size 100
forest-tool car validate sha256-pack.forest.car.zst
```

The output SHA-256 is
`f98242ca7505a39e3d28390fc8ec682a1f5aff469bd1bb16fa0d4cc630823246`.
The fixture contains four indexed SHA-256 CID blocks. It tests this bounded
Otehon profile, not Forest's complete multihash or large-snapshot support.
